output_dir.description: Directory where extracted MIB/PIB module files will be written. Corresponds to the -d flag.

module_name.description: Specific module name to extract (e.g., 'IPV6-MIB'). If empty, all modules in input are extracted. Corresponds to the -m flag.

input_files.description: List of input text files (RFCs/I-Ds) to process. If empty, smistrip reads from stdin. Corresponds to file(s) argument.

dry_run.description: If true, prints what would be extracted without writing output files. Corresponds to the -n flag.
